_doc: Vetted archival sources — OWNER-EDITED ONLY. This allowlist authorizes SOURCES, never matches artists: no code path writes here, and automation may VALIDATE entries (playability, channel membership via scripts/validate-archival.mjs) but never DISCOVER them. Every entry needs evidence of institutional legitimacy.
